meta.source: sherdog.com fighter pages (pro fight history), fetched by tools/preufc.py at <= 1 request/s; raw HTML cached in data/raw/sherdog_cache/ (gitignored)
meta.targets: roster (fighters.json) + every fighter with 0-3 prior UFC bouts in a UFC bout on/after 2015-01-01
meta.walk_forward: snapshots[k] uses only Sherdog pro fights dated strictly before the k-th UFC bout's date; rows matched to ufcstats bouts (or any UFC-promoted row) are UFC experience and never count in the non-UFC record; amateur and exhibition (TUF house) fights are excluded from the record (exh_n/exh_w count exhibitions)

fields.n w l d nc: non-UFC pro record before the bout (w+l+d = n)
fields.ko_w sub_w dec_w oth_w / ko_l sub_l dec_: non-UFC wins and losses by method (KO includes TKO; oth = DQ and other)
fields.streak: non-UFC win streak at the end of the non-UFC record (entering the UFC for a debut)
fields.streak_all / lstreak_all: overall pro win / loss streak entering the bout (UFC included)
fields.l5_w l5_n: wins in the last (up to) 5 non-UFC fights
fields.n_ufc_sd: UFC bouts Sherdog lists before this bout
fields.years_active: years from pro debut to the bout
fields.layoff_days: days since the last pro fight of any kind
fields.n_2y: pro fights in the 2 years before
fields.promos / last_promo / n_promos: non-UFC promotions (Sherdog event-name prefix, big orgs merged)
fields.dwcs_w dwcs_n: Dana White's Contender Series wins / fights (not in ufcstats)
fields.promo_feed: mean over the last 6 non-UFC fights of log(1 + 1000 x share of all UFC debutants before the bout date who came through that promotion); graduates counted only from meta.graduates_from on, where the target set holds every debut (older debuts are survivors only)
fields.promo_feed_max: max of the same over the last 6 non-UFC fights
fields.promo_grad: mean over the last 6 non-UFC fights of the promotion's graduates' win rate in their first 3 UFC bouts before the bout date (shrunk to 0.5 with 10 pseudo-bouts)
fields.opp_wpct / opp_known: mean pre-fight win share of non-UFC opponents with >= 3 fights seen in the Sherdog network (union of every cached page), and how many such opponents
fields.opp_ufc_w / opp_ufc_n: non-UFC wins / fights against opponents who had a UFC bout before the bout date
fields.net_elo: Elo over every fight in the Sherdog network (K 32, start 1500), as of the bout date. The network is the union of every cached page, and which pages are cached depends on who reached the UFC later: kept for reference, the models use net_elo_h
fields.net_elo_h / opp_wpct_h / opp_known_h: strict walk-forward versions (class StrictNetwork): a bout in year Y uses only pages of UFC debutants with first UFC bout in [graduates_from, Jan 1 Y) (a complete set, chosen by facts known before Y) plus the fighter's own rows (one-sided Elo walk when his page is not in that network); opponents' win share uses their record before the fight date in the same network (>= 3 known fights)
fields.exh_n exh_w: exhibition (TUF house) fights / wins before the bout
fields.snapshots: one row per UFC bout in meta.snapshot_columns order (walk-forward features)
fields.debut: the first snapshot as a dict (the record entering the UFC), plus date and fid
fields.fights: [date, result, method class, promotion, opponent, opponent sherdog id, round, ufcstats fight id or 'UFC' for UFC rows ufcstats lacks or '' for non-UFC]
fields.current: the same features as of today (non-UFC record including fights between or after UFC stints)

design.rows: decisive UFC bouts (draws and no-contests excluded) where at least one side had 0-3 prior UFC bouts; train/tune [2015-01-01, 2024-01-01), time-ordered CV years [2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023] (fit on all earlier years, score year Y); validation 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-13 scored once; fights from 2026-01-01 (the vault) are never fit or scored here
design.elo: walk-forward Elo over every UFC bout since 1994, K=44, boost 1.5 for the first 5 UFC bouts (tools/build_db.py rule; reproduced exactly)
design.base: symmetric no-intercept logistic on side differences: Elo, age, reach, height, log(1+n UFC), UFC win log-odds, UFC finish win / finished-loss rates, layoff, shrunk decayed UFC rates (sig landed/absorbed per min, accuracy, defense, TD/15, TD acc, TD def, sub att/15, KD/15 for and against, control for and against)
design.pre: Sherdog pre-UFC features per side from snapshots dated strictly before the bout, imputed at the train mean when unresolved (no missing-data flag: resolution order could leak), faded by exp(-n_UFC/tau)
design.seeded_elo: Elo whose debut rating is 1500 + beta . z(pre-UFC record at debut [+ age at debut]); beta fit by minimizing Elo log loss on train newcomer bouts; every later bout uses the same Elo updates

audit.note: the strict network (StrictNetwork) is the default; the earlier run of this tool scored 2024+ with the full network, so these 2024+ numbers are a second look at the held-out years
